documentation: Where the La Liga build downloads from, and which competition rules it uses. Season, clubs, kickoffs and averages are not in this file. Model tuning stays in model.json.
player_note: Click a column heading to sort, and a row for the player's profile. Win probability added is how many expected points the player's goals were worth to the club at that moment. Points added by goals is how many league points those goals were worth. A winning goal is the one that put the club ahead for good. A solo goal has no assist and is not a penalty. Shots and xG come from Understat. Passes, duels, goalkeeping and transfer values are not in that feed, so those columns are left out.
cup_clause: The Copa del Rey is not included, so a cup week can look quieter than it was.
history_phrase: earlier La Liga and Segunda División results
absence_note: Injury news is not listed. No free La Liga injury feed was reliable enough to publish.
omitted_note: Possession, carry counts, goalkeeper logs, transfer values and the Fantasy-style price list are not in the free shot feed, so those sections are hidden. Pressing volume is shown only when the shot feed publishes it.
banner: Same ideas as the Premier League page, fed by the public shot file and historical league results. Sections that those feeds do not cover are hidden, not filled in.
credit: Shots, xG and the fixture list: Understat (public site, no key; the JSON is what their own page requests). Scores are checked against football-data.co.uk La Liga results, and bookmaker columns in that file are not read. Pre-season strength uses La Liga and Segunda results from the same site. European dates: ESPN's public football schedule. No bookmaker prices. Independent, unofficial.
